title: In the margins
author: Subhro
description: An independent little journal. Everyday observations, unfinished thoughts, and words worth keeping.
headline: A little life,
intro: Things I notice. Words I collect. Thoughts that need somewhere to go. A small corner of the internet, at my own pace.
about: This is a place for paying attention. To ordinary days, passing thoughts, and things that might otherwise slip away. Some entries are a few lines; others take the long way around.
note: Not everything needs to become something. Some things can just be noticed.

notifications.prompt: Quiet notifications when a new journal entry is published.
